string.name: Settings_AppleHealthPreferences_Message
string.value:
If the Sync options are enabled the app tries to synchronise with Huawei Health, so new data by this app is automatically saved to the Health App and if the weight in Huawei Health changes it automatically gets adjusted here too.

Should the 'Auto Import Workouts' option be enabled, the app tries to automatically import new workouts added by other apps into the local database.

'Sync All Unsynced Workouts' synchronises all Workouts in this app, not already in synced, to Huawei Health.

string.name: Settings_DataPreferences_Message
string.value:
Backups in OutRun, probably unlike in most other apps, are just files, that you do not need special tools to insert into the app or transfer to another device. They also stay local (unless you save them in the cloud).

When creating a backup you will be presented with a '.orbup' file that you can share to whatever other app you want to. Be aware, that the data inside of that file is not encrypted though, sending it to someone or uploading it to a service can compromise your privacy, so please keep that in mind.

To import a backup just select a '.orbup' file from wherever you previously saved it, the app will then import all the workouts contained in the backup, making sure there are no duplicates automatically.

string.name: Settings_GPSAccuracy_Text
string.value:
When receiving GPS signals they are sent with a certain accuracy for determining if the data is adequate for use. Depending on how you set this filter will your recorded workouts vary in quality.

Ideally the filter should stay at 'Standard', but should there be complications with your data (e.g. it being too inaccurate or everything being filtered out) you can try one of the others.

string.name: Settings_RecordingPreferences_Message
string.value:
Should you experience any kind of crashes or similar behaviour while recording a workout, you should try to turn 'Show Map' to off, because most of these crashes known where related to the map drawing too much power.

If 'Display Pace' is enabled instead of showing the speed the pace is shown. Should 'Display Rolling Speed' be on the speed or pace displayed are an average of the last kilometer, if not the current speed or the total pace are shown.

string.name: Setup_Introduction
string.value:
the running app that actually cares about your privacy, where you don't have to create a user account, or give sensitive data that then lies on a server in the middle of nowhere.
But more of that later for now let's just get started.

string.name: Setup_Feature_Route_Message
string.value: Record your running, walking or cycling workouts with the highest accuracy possible on your phone.

string.name: Setup_Feature_Chart_Message
string.value: Look at detailed statistics like top speed and your average pace after you finished your workout

string.name: Setup_Feature_Lock_Message
string.value: Don't worry about your data, all of it stays on your device as long as you want it to.

string.name: Setup_Formalities_Title
string.value: I guess let's start with the formalities

string.name: Setup_Formalities_Message
string.value: This is the most boring part of the setup, so let's get it over with. If you don't want to read the policies (which we totally get) here is a really small summary: All your data is saved locally (with the exception of syncronization with Huawei Health), so you stay in control of it and don't need to worry about any kind of leak or exploit.

string.name: Setup_UserInfo_Title
string.value: But now let's talk about You

string.name: Setup_UserInfo_Message
string.value: To enable some of the features in this app we need some basic information on you. Your weight for example is required to calculate the approximate energy burned in a workout. (To give us your name is totally optional)

string.name: Setup_AppleHealth_Title
string.value: Want to sync with Huawei Health?

string.name: Setup_AppleHealth_Message
string.value: If you want your data to be stored in a central space Huawei Health might be a good option since it's well intregated with HarmonyOS. The synchronization is totally optional though and it should be noted that if you choose to sync with Huawei Health your data will possibly leave your phone and be stored on Huawei servers, more on that in the privacy policy. If you choose to enable Auto Import the app tries to import workouts added by other apps into the local database so you keep an overview over all your workouts.

string.name: Setup_Permissions_Title
string.value: Now we just need your permission

string.name: Setup_Permissions_Message
string.value: Since we want to provide our services to you we need access to some APIs like Location Services or if you want to sync with Huawei Health also access to read and write to that service.

string.name: Setup_Permission_Location_Message
string.value: We need your location to record the route and thereby also important information like distance of the workouts you record in this app.

string.name: Setup_Permission_Location_Restricted_Message
string.value: We can only access your location while this app is open right now. For tracking a workout it is advisable to give background location access, so your phone does not have to be on with the app open the entire time. To give us 'Always' access to your location you have to open your phone's settings and change it manually.

string.name: Setup_Permission_Location_Error
string.value: It seems like you have not granted us the permission to record your location. Please note that this is required for our service to work. To change this setting you have to go into your phone's Settings and grant us permission. Afterwards press the button again. Do you want to open Settings?

string.name: Setup_Permission_AppleHealth_Message
string.value: Since you want us to save your workouts/weight to Huawei Health we require permission from you to read and write to the Huawei Health Store regarding the synced categories.

string.value: You seem to not have been allowing us to access every requested category from Huawei Health. Do you want to try again or turn off syncronisation?

string.name: Changelog_1_2_2
string.value:
After receiving a trademark complaint "OutRun" will now be called "Out-Run" in the UK. This update has the main purpose of addressing this complaint.

Additionally it contains the following bug fixes:

- sometimes data was not added properly to Apple Health, this should now be fixed
- ascending and descending altitude were swapped in the statistics, now they are in the right order
- there have been some style issues because of changes in iOS 14, everything should look normally again

And for this update nothing more changed.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to reach out at outrun@tadris.de.

Tim, the Developer.

string.name: Changelog_1_3
string.value:
It has been quite a long time since the last update and while I am still working on some more fundamental changes to OutRun this update also marks a huge step in the evolution of this app.

I am very happy to announce that OutRun will now be available in ELEVEN additional languages which brings us to a total of thirteen and all of that thanks to a few really great people, who can be found in this project's README inside the source-code repository.

Other than that not much has changed in this version:

- There is a new contributor tab in settings, listing all the people who have considerably added to OutRun
- and the source-code button was moved from 'Support' to 'App-Info'

And that is that.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to reach out at outrun@tadris.de.

Tim, the Developer.
